# Phoenix Story Truth + Place-Causality Gate Record

**Status:** BINDING REVIEW ARTIFACT TEMPLATE  
**Authority:** `PHOENIX_NARRATIVE_AND_DISCOVERY_STANDARD.md` §18

This is a review-record template, not a parallel narrative standard. It exists so future Journey proposals can submit the evidence required by the binding Narrative standard without inventing their own format.

## Identity

```text
Journey ID:
Candidate Story ID:
Reviewer:
Candidate fingerprint version:
Approved-Gold catalog count:
```

## FACT FIRST

```text
Authoritative source ID:
Authority class:
Citation / URL record:
Verified facts supported:
Material Story premise supported: YES / NO
```

For every material premise:

```text
Claim ID:
Claim:
Classification: VERIFIED FACT / FICTIONAL CHARACTER ACTION / FICTIONAL DIALOGUE / FICTIONAL PERSONAL MOTIVATION / INTERPRETIVE STORY DEVICE / UNSUPPORTED FACTUAL CLAIM
Source IDs when VERIFIED FACT:
Material to Goal / Conflict / Choice / Climax / Consequence / Transformation / Ending / Cultural Anchor / Engine:
Result:
```

Any `UNSUPPORTED FACTUAL CLAIM` is `BLOCKED`.

## REAL HISTORICAL PERSON REVIEW

```text
Real historical person present: YES / NO
Factual action / intention / dialogue asserted:
Exact authoritative evidence:
Observed effect distinguished from documented intention: YES / NO
Result:
```
